rationale: Tests knowledge of the aetiology classification (organic vs non-organic) of FTT at the conclusion of the pathophysiology section.
Tests the counselling principle that blame-free, collaborative communication is essential when explaining non-organic FTT to a caregiver.
Checks the precise WHO/IAP definition of short stature and the threshold for severe short stature, which underpins all subsequent assessment decisions.
Tests cause-directed management of short stature — specifically growth hormone therapy indications — at the conclusion of the management section.
